baseline.selection: Exact durable674 checkpoint, no portable parameter reset, optimizer/RNG/environment/counters retained. This baseline has no claimed strength evaluation.

candidate.global_budget: At most12hours wall time from the first actual training start across all one-hour cycles and reviewed revisions, or available legitimate free GPU quota/provider service first. Export waits,development evaluation and editing do not reset or extend this clock.
candidate.development_selection: After each healthy cycle and durable checkpoint ACK, run the fixed development benchmark. Compare only development outcomes and health before selecting a checkpoint or proposing a reviewed tweak. Every revised artifact requires fresh host and physical gates before training; no unreviewed live mutation.
candidate.final_selection: At the global deadline or earlier legitimate provider/quota stop, select one externally durable healthy approved-version checkpoint using development evidence and health only. Record exact source/checkpoint hashes and selection rationale before any final heldout gameplay.
candidate.incomplete_or_unavailable_final_evaluati: If the selected checkpoint is not externally durable/source-approved or legitimate free GPU quota is unavailable, retain the checkpoint and report final holdout pending/inconclusive. Do not bypass a limit or invent a result.
candidate.training_rng: Continue exact674 seed42-derived optimizer/RNG/environment/counter state; no reset. A reviewed future RNG change must be separately disclosed before execution.
candidate.evaluation_benchmark_freeze: Freeze evaluation source,opponent module,IDgrid,parameters,deals and settings for the entire12hour campaign,even if training artifacts are reviewed and tweaked. Never change the yardstick after seeing development outcomes. Compare prior candidate reports only on the identical benchmark bindings.

opponent_split.encoding: Legacy0..12 unchanged. NewID=13+64*family+variant. Other combinations invalid and forbidden for training.
opponent_split.parameter_coefficients: Exact numeric coefficients and family-specific rules are pinned by opponent_manifest_sha256. They must be fixed before training; no coefficient tuning using heldout outputs.
opponent_split.training_match_sampling: For scripted match assignments only,50%uniform legacy13 and50%uniform new training families, each with uniform32training variants. Existing kind/team/snapshot key streams retained.
opponent_split.match_persistence: Encoded style ID persists through the full match; only a completed-match reset samples another ID.
opponent_split.heldout_ids_in_training: Forbidden in every native league_style element, irrespective of league_kind. Negative,reserved,unknown IDs also forbidden.

holdout_firewall.outcomes_before_final_evaluation: None. Repeated development evaluation is allowed only on the declared development IDs/seeds. Final heldout outcomes may not tune coefficients, select a policy, lengthen training or trigger another evaluation campaign.
holdout_firewall.host_rule_tests: Legality, hidden-information and deterministic source tests may exercise heldout rule code without model win-rate evaluation. Such checks must not tune coefficients by playing strength.
holdout_firewall.seed_scope: Explicit evaluation seed labels are disjoint from training/development labels. Training continues674RNG unchanged; this metadata alone is not proof that every future PRNG key is distinct. Audit and retain exact evaluation root keys.
holdout_firewall.reuse: One final heldout campaign with the two predeclared seeds, after checkpoint selection is recorded from development/health. If invalid/incomplete, retain raw evidence and report inconclusive; no automatic rerun or replacement checkpoint.

primary_evaluation.learner_team_order: [0,1] repeated128times; each root is played once per learner team.
primary_evaluation.same_deals: For each seed and styleID use16roots from split(fold_in(PRNGKey(seed),styleID),16). Both policies share exactroots and[0,1] roles; differentIDs use distinct recorded rootsets. No outcome-dependent root selection.
primary_evaluation.raw_evidence: Retain source/config/checkpoint hashes, exact pair roots, team roles, completed flags, engine winners, final scores, per-game illegal counts, hands, accumulated scores and outcomes for every policy/style/seed.

secondary_regression.purpose: Report legacy13 coverage and possible regressions separately; it is not the novel-family primary endpoint and cannot replace a failed primary result.

statistics.win_credit: Completed learner-team win1, true engine draw0.5, loss0. Unresolved games receive no outcome credit.
statistics.invalid_handling: Any illegal action, nonfinite output, invalid engine result, mismatched roots/roles or unresolved game invalidates the campaign; stop and retain raw evidence. Never recode unfinished games as draws or silently drop pairs.
statistics.primary_estimand: Equal-heldout-family and equal-variant mean paired win-credit difference: candidate minus frozen674baseline. Twofamilies×32variants make this equal to an equal-ID mean.
statistics.cluster: A complete duplicate-deal pair within a fixed styleID. Both policies share that root. Rootsets differ across styleIDs. Resample pair indices jointly across both policies within eachID, independently acrossIDs, then average equally over variants and families. This is a stratified paired-cluster bootstrap on a fixed ID grid.
statistics.interval: Separate nominal95% percentile stratified paired-cluster intervals per final seed. Never pool seeds after inspection. Per-ID intervals have only16clusters and remain weak exploratory summaries.
statistics.exploratory_intervals: Report family,variant and legacy-style point estimates and nominal intervals as exploratory; no multiplicity adjustment or universal-expert claim.
statistics.evidence_rule: Both primary aggregate lower confidence bounds must exceed0 and neither heldout-family interval may have an upper bound below0. This supports only further validation; no automatic promotion. Report secondary regressions without replacing primary endpoints.
statistics.uncertainty_limit: One initial training lineage/seed42; fixed-grid paired game intervals exclude training-seed and unseen-family uncertainty. Many related variants do not establish64independent strategic families.
statistics.development_interpretation: Repeated fixed-development results support local selection/tweaks only; their confidence intervals are not untouched-holdout evidence.

before_training: Fresh authorized freeT4 session only; exact6package CUDA12 stack and selected physical UUID/PCI/driver mapping.
Exact674package/native fullcfg214state validation before any launch; native style allowlist validation before compile/load transfer where possible and after restoration.
Initial checkpoint external Library upload/readback/ACK; full-config healthy675 smoke24/24 finite/legal work; second durable ACK; actual15minute export/readback/ACK.
before_final_evaluation: Global12hour deadline or earlier legitimate service/quota termination reached; select one healthy externally durable approved checkpoint using development/health only,record choice before heldout gameplay.
Independently validate both674baseline and selected candidate source/config/native hashes and full finite state.
Review and freeze the separate definitions-only diversity evaluation launcher; pass host fixtures and actual selected-board AOT memory/finite/legal gates. No implicit final-evaluation launch occurs.
Actual evaluation AOT memory admission, legal/finite checks, bounded service authorization and immutable raw output export.

preserved_training_cadence.clock_starts: First actual training launch; persists across reviewed revisions and includes export/evaluation/idle time.
preserved_training_cadence.periodic_checkpoint_note: The earlier3hour/90minute segment contract is superseded by the user hourly-cycle instruction. The operator records the new hourly/15minute schedule explicitly.

current_status: Protocol and implementation candidate only; no diversity training,development evaluation,final heldout evaluation,CUDA12 numerical equivalence or playing-strength improvement established.

development_evaluation.purpose: Repeated selection/tweak evidence after each one-hour training cycle; these reused games are development data,never final generalization evidence.
development_evaluation.paired_comparison: Within each styleID, both policies play identical16rootkeys with[0,1] learner team roles. Rootkey sets differ across IDs via fold_in(seed,styleID).
development_evaluation.selection_score: Equal-style mean candidate win credit minus frozen674baseline, with legality/resolution/finite gates. Repeated selection on this score is allowed and explicitly development-only.
development_evaluation.invalid_action: Stop evaluation,retain raw evidence and leave cycle review unapproved; do not treat partial games as comparable scores.
development_evaluation.baseline_reuse: May reuse only an exact hash-bound baseline raw evaluation on the same fixed development roots,policy parameters,evaluation source and settings. Otherwise evaluate baseline again. No approximate/source-mismatched cache.
